63700.synonym: makhādeva, magghadeva, maghadeva, māgha, vajirahattha, vāsava, sahassakkha, sahassanetta
63700.commentary: (SN) sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānam'indassa sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpati, tasmā sujampatī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānam'indassa sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpati, tasmā sujampatī'ti vuccati.

63701.commentary: (SNa) jivhā sujā'ti yathā tuyhaṃ suvaṇṇa-rajata-loha-kaṭṭha-mattikāsu aññataramayā yāgayajan'atthāya sujā hoti, evaṃ mayhaṃ dhammayāgaṃ yajan'atthāya pahūtajivhā sujā'ti vadati.

examples.text: māno hi te brāhmaṇa khāribhāro, kodho dhūmo bhasmani mosavajjaṃ, jivhā sujā hadayaṃ jotiṭhānaṃ, attā sudanto purisassa joti.
sakkassa, bhikkhave, devānam'indassa sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpati, tasmā sujampatī'ti vuccati.
ehi sārathi gacchāhi, rathaṃ niyyādayāh'imaṃ, ārogyaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ vajja, pabbaji dāni brāhmaṇo, sujāto tīhi rattīhi, tisso vijjā aphassayi.
idha, bhikkhave, rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca. yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññe'pi bhaddā ass'ājānīyā jāyanti, tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti.
so yā tā sālalaṭṭhiyo kuṭilā oj'āpaharaṇiyo tā chetvā bahiddhā nīhareyya, antovanaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya. yā pana tā sālalaṭṭhiyo ujukā sujātā tā sammā parihareyya.
caviya punaridh'āgato samāno, paṭilabhati idha tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, bhavati vipuladīghapāsaṇhiko, brahmā'va suju subho sujātagatto.

63705.commentary: (DNt) sujātagatto subhujo'ti ādayo sarīr'āvayavaguṇā imehi lakkhaṇehi avinābhāvino'ti dassetuṃ vuttā.

examples.text: caviya punaridh'āgato samāno, paṭilabhati idha tīṇi lakkhaṇāni, bhavati vipuladīghapāsaṇhiko, brahmā'va suju subho sujātagatto.

63710.commentary: (ANa) upāsikāpāḷiyā paṭhame paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchantīnan'ti sabbapaṭhamaṃ saraṇesu patiṭṭhitānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, sujātā nāma, seniyadhītā aggā'ti dasseti. sā'pi padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattā aparabhāge satthu dhammakathaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsikaṃ paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchantīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikāraṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā amhākaṃ satthu nibbattito puretaram'eva uruvelāyaṃ senānigame seniyakuṭumbikassa gehe nibbattitvā vayappattā ekasmiṃ nigrodhamūle patthanaṃ akāsi, sace samajātikaṃ kulagharaṃ gantvā paṭhamagabbhe puttaṃ labhissāmi, anusaṃvaccharaṃ balikammaṃ karissāmī'ti. tassā sā patthanā samijjhi.

examples.text: sudatto nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo? sujātā nāma, bhante, upāsikā nātike kālaṅ'katā, tassā kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo? kukkuṭo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchantīnaṃ yadidaṃ sujātā seniyadhītā.

63713.meaning1: (of life) easy (for); comfortable (for); easy to live (by)

diṭṭhena ce suddhi narassa hoti, ñāṇena vā so pajahāti dukkhaṃ, aññena so sujjhati sopadhīko, diṭṭhī hi naṃ pāva tathā vadānaṃ.

examples.text: yāvatā kho, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo, akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam'akkhāyati. sā kho pan'ākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena, suññā dosena, suññā mohena.

atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu pāṭaligāmikesu upāsakesu suñña-agāraṃ pāvisi
kacci nu kho'haṃ suññ'āgāre abhiramāmī'ti, pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
so passeyya suññaṃ gāmaṃ. yaññad'eva gharaṃ paviseyya rittakaññ'eva paviseyya tucchakaññ'eva paviseyya suññakaññ'eva paviseyya.
yo suññagehāni sevati, seyyo so muni attasaññato, vossajja careyya tattha so, patirūpañ'hi tathāvidhassa taṃ.

ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatappaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.

63736.meaning1: connected to emptiness; concerned with voidness; related to non-subjectivity

examples.text: te abhāvitakāyā samānā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatāppaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti, na sotaṃ odahissanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapessanti, na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.

63738.meaning1: appearance of emptiness; occurrence of voidness

examples.text: iti yañ'hi kho tattha na hoti tena taṃ suññaṃ samanupassati, yaṃ pana tattha avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti taṃ santam'idaṃ atthī'ti pajānāti. evam'pi'ssa esā, ānanda, yathābhuccā avipallatthā parisuddhā suññat'āvakkanti bhavati.

examples.text: vippasannāni kho te, sāriputta, indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto. katamena kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, vihārena eta'r'ahi bahulaṃ viharasī'ti? suññatāvihārena kho ahaṃ, bhante, eta'r'ahi bahulaṃ viharāmī'ti.

so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.

araññe rukkhamūle vā, suññ'āgāre'va bhikkhavo, anussaretha sambuddhaṃ, bhayaṃ tumhāka no siyā.

63747.commentary: (DNa) suññ'āgārahatā'ti suññ'āgāresu naṭṭhā, samaṇena hi gotamena bodhimūle appamattikā paññā adhigatā, sā'pi'ssa suññ'āgāresu ekakassa nisīdato naṭṭhā. yadi pana mayaṃ viya gaṇasaṅgaṇikaṃ katvā nisīdeyya, n'āssa paññā nasseyyā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gokāṇā pariyantacārinī antam'antān'eva sevati. evam'eva suññ'āgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparis'āvacaro samaṇo gotamo, n'ālaṃ sallāpāya. so antam'antān'eva sevati.

63749.meaning1: well; good; right; most certainly; extremely

examples.text: sumatikataṃ [sumattikataṃ, ettha matisaddo kaṭṭhakhettassa samīkaraṇasādhane dārubhaṇḍe vattatī'ti sakkata-abhidhānesu āgataṃ. taṃ matiyā suṭṭhu samīkatan'ti aṭṭhakathāya sameti]
passatha, bhante, taṃ āpattiṃ. āma, āvuso, passāmi. āyatiṃ, bhante, saṃvareyyātha. sādhu suṭṭhu, āvuso, saṃvarissāmi.

yathā vā pana, mahārāja, mayaṃ idha pāsāde nisinnā imesu jālavātapānesu ugghāṭitesu mahantena ākāsena bahimukhā suṭṭhutaraṃ rūpaṃ passāma, evam'etena abbhantare jīvenā'pi cakkhudvāresu ugghāṭitesu mahantena ākāsena suṭṭhutaraṃ rūpaṃ passitabbaṃ… ?
āvellitasiṅgiko hi meṇḍo, na ca sunakhassa visāṇakāni atthi, tiṇabhakkho maṃsabhojano ca, atha meṇḍassa suṇena sakhyam'assa.
yath'āssa suṇato saddaṃ, sevato c'āpi vedanaṃ, khīyati n'opacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato, evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbānam'uccati.
ākāse pakkhandā pakkhino'pi pakkhe pasāretvā taṃ saddaṃ suṇamānā'va tiṭṭhanti. udake macchā'pi kaṇṇapaṭalaṃ papphoṭetvā taṃ saddaṃ suṇamānā'va tiṭṭhanti. evaṃ madhurassarā karavīkā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rañño vā rājamah'āmattassa vā vīṇāya saddo assutapubbo assa. so vīṇāsaddaṃ suṇeyya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ambho, kassa nu kho eso saddo evaṃrajanīyo evaṃkamanīyo evaṃmadanīyo evaṃmucchanīyo evaṃbandhanīyo'ti?
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.
pariññeyye ca, bhikkhave, dhamme desessāmi pariññañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha. katame ca, bhikkhave, pariññeyyā dhammā?

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rañño vā rājamah'āmattassa vā vīṇāya saddo assutapubbo assa. so vīṇāsaddaṃ suṇeyya.

63788.meaning1: nurtured by knowledge; fortified by learning; matured by learning

examples.text: yassa kassaci, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ…
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, api nu te ito pubbe evarūpā anupubb'ābhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpatti sutapubbā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ na nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ na vissajjeti. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā sutappayā'ti.

63791.meaning1: merely what is heard; only what is heard; hearing itself

examples.text: tasmā't'iha te, bāhiya, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

63792.commentary: (DNa) tattha katamā sutamayā paññā? yogavihitesu vā kamm'āyatanesu… dhammanijjhānakkhantiṃ parato sutvā paṭilabhati, ayaṃ vuccati sutamayā paññā.

examples.text: aparā'pi tisso paññā, cintāmayā paññā, sutamayā paññā, bhāvanāmayā paññā.
me sutan'ti ettha mayā-sadd'attho me-saddo, sotadvāraviññāṇ'attho sutasaddo. tasmā evaṃ me sutan'ti evaṃ mayā sotaviññāṇapubbaṅ'gamāya viññāṇavīthiyā upadhāritan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

63794.meaning1: storing up learning; who accumulates knowledge
63794.commentary: (ANa) sutasannicayo'ti sutassa sannicayabhūto. yassa hi sutaṃ hadayamañjūsāya sannicitaṃ silāya lekhā viya suvaṇṇapatte pakkhittasīhavasā viya ca tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ sutasannicayo nāma.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo
bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo.

63795.meaning1: attainment of learning; success in studies

examples.text: katamā pañca? saddhāsampadā, sīlasampadā, sutasampadā, cāgasampadā, paññāsampadā, imā kho, bhikkhave, pañca sampadā'ti.
taṃ kissa hetu? tañ'hi so, bhikkhave, sutasampadaṃ attani na samanupassati, na ca labhati tatonidānaṃ pītipāmojjaṃ. tasmā appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā.
tatra, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho eta'r'ahi rūpena khajjāmi. atītam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjiṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmi
idha, gahapati, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati
evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī'ti.
